verdict.rationale: Anthropic's Commercial Terms set out plain-language commitments on ownership and data handling: customers retain rights to their Inputs, own their Outputs, and Anthropic may not train on Customer Content. The platform docs add that retained data is never used for training without permission and document data-residency controls. The evidence never shows the prohibited-uses half of the policy; only Acceptable Use enforcement reporting is mentioned, not the policy text itself. Missing for 10: documented acceptable-use policy listing prohibited uses, evidence of what founders may build commercially, independent corroboration of policy clarity.

support.subject: As a founder, the usage policy is clear about what I may build — prohibited uses, commercial terms, and data-handling commitments in plain language

citations.quote: Anthropic agrees that Customer (a) retains all rights to its Inputs, and (b) owns its Outputs.
Anthropic may not train models on Customer Content from Services.
Data residency controls let you manage where your data is processed and stored.
